answer.held_back_by: A hidden ceiling that was set by the party and my file, not by my work. Even with 100 rep, 100 integrity and outstanding appraisals, STAND kept sliding and the system had already decided where I would stop. I think challenging the pay system in Y42 cost me, too.
answer.ending_fair_why: It was oddly fair because it explained the ceiling and the rumours, and it matched the pattern I suspected. It was also quietly cruel that nothing I did could change it for most of the run, and that I only learned the rules at the end.
answer.chase_next: The 85 everything-surfaces ending, or Senior Minister of State and above. I want to find out what the hidden scandals do if I leave my secrets alone, and whether playing the politics gets past the ceiling.
answer.play_again_why: The life was long and I played 46 years to learn the ceiling existed. I would want a break first, though I am curious enough that I would try again with the ending card in mind.

tone_breaks.line: HR calls me 'a safe pair of hands'
tone_breaks.note: Not really a break, just a lot of Singapore jargon like MR4, STAND and the Leadership Programme that was never explained to someone who does not know the system.

answer.title_fit_why: The game is about being confirmed in a role and what the system thinks of you, not about pay. My salary barely mattered, whereas the appraisals and the ceiling were the whole story.

MAYA TORRES · THE FINAL POSITION
Retired, Honourably

You served. The service continued. Both of these facts are entirely unremarkable and that is the highest compliment the system can pay.

RETIRED AS Minister
AT AGE 72
LIFETIME EARNINGS $50.79M
INTEGRITY 100

DECLASSIFIED
YOUR CEILING: When you joined, your file put no ceiling on you inside the service. Most people's files do.
THE PARTY'S ESTIMATE: When you won your seat, the party made its own: Senior Minister of State. Nobody told you that either.
THE YEAR IT CHANGED: At 44, in Polling Day, Again, you chose "Walk every block, every night, for nine days." It raised your ceiling to Minister.
THE RUMOURS, TRANSLATED: "At the division lunch, you are seated facing the door." meant: your work had earned a promotion and your ceiling refused it. You were told this 22 times.
EXPOSURE: Your scandal exposure peaked at 43 out of 100, after "The National Bonus" at age 67. At 85, everything surfaces at once.
LEGACY: People you trained quote you in rooms you will never enter. Two of them say you are the reason they stayed.
